prompts.continuity_addon: Continue seamlessly from the last frame shown in {continuity_ref}: same pose, lighting and camera position at the start of this clip.
prompts.subtitle_addon: Show burned-in subtitles of the spoken line: {translated_text}
prompts.voice_addon: The character speaks this line with natural lip sync: {translated_text}
prompts.transcribe_translate:
You are a precise speech transcriber. The attached audio files are listed in this manifest (frame_id, order, file_name, duration_seconds):
{audio_manifest}

For EACH attached file, listen to that file only and write exactly what is spoken, word for word, in the original spoken language. Do not summarise, correct or add words. If a file has no intelligible speech (music, noise, silence), set has_speech to false and transcript to an empty string.

Also translate each transcript into {target_language} and put it in translated_text. Keep the meaning and tone; do not add explanations.
prompts.transcribe_translate_full_audio:
You are a precise speech transcriber. One audio file is attached for each item of this manifest (frame_id, order, file_name, duration_seconds):
{audio_manifest}

The files are consecutive parts of one continuous recording. Transcribe EACH file on its own, word for word, in the original spoken language, without moving words between files. If a file has no intelligible speech, set has_speech to false and transcript to an empty string.

Also translate each transcript into {target_language} and put it in translated_text. Keep the meaning and tone; do not add explanations.
